race.comment: FRIENDZONED (14) is racing consistently, beaten a long neck in a Class 1 at Bendigo two back before another good effort at Seymour. Back a fair way in grade now and will be charging late. BRUTIFY (9) scooted away to win impressively at Wodonga last time out in tricky conditions, putting up a strong figure in the process. Drawn a bit tricky here, but if she gets some luck in the early stages then she'll be hard to fend off late. BABY BLUE (13) is lightly raced, winning her maiden two back at Ballarat Synthetic before another good effort there. She was okay on heavy on debut and can improve again. LORD PORCHESTER (7) won narrowly when last seen before a freshen and can figure again.
